summary: Fixed the rework finding in src/api/httpClient.ts. Every POST/PUT/PATCH now sends Content-Type: application/json, and a write with no body sends `{}`, so start/complete diagnosis and archive/restore company no longer get 415 json_required. requireJsonWrites stays as it is. The same root cause also dropped the server's extra error keys (`fields`, `pendingBlocks`), so the client now fills ApiError.details with error.details when the server sends it, and with the remaining non-envelope keys otherwise. CompanyFormDialog (details.fields) and diagnosesApi (details.pendingBlocks) already read those keys.

findings.summary: The regression reproduction is a scratch script in the run-scoped temp dir (real httpClient through the real requireJsonWrites guard via a fetch stub), not a permanent test, because tests/** is outside the frontend write paths. The end-to-end check against the real createApp (tests/api or tests/e2e) belongs to integration.

evidence.result: Before the fix: exit 1 with 7 FAIL (415 json_required on body-less POST start/complete/archive/restore and PUT, plus server fields/pendingBlocks missing from details). After the fix: exit 0 with 12/12 PASS (writes with a body unchanged, GET/DELETE send no body or content type, explicit error.details kept, requestId kept).

acceptance.AC-dm-17: unchanged from the previous attempt; primitives build
acceptance.AC-dm-48: unchanged from the previous attempt; ConfirmDialog built on Radix AlertDialog

messages.text: httpClient now sends Content-Type: application/json on every POST/PUT/PATCH, with body `{}` when the caller passes none (diagnosesApi start/complete, companiesApi archive/restore). DELETE and GET send no body and no content type. requireJsonWrites is unchanged. Please confirm with the real createApp: start diagnosis 201, complete, archive, restore no longer 415 (for example, add a tests/api case or run tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts and questionnaire.spec.ts).

ApiError.details is now error.details when the server sends it, otherwise an object with the extra keys of the error body except code/message/requestId (for example { fields } for 400 validation_failed, { pendingBlocks } for 422 incomplete). CompanyFormDialog.readServerFieldErrors and diagnosesApi.blocksFromDetails now receive these directly; the diagnosesApi draft-recompute fallback still works but is no longer the main path.
